newsitem.title: USA: Carolina Fincorp unit had Q1 loss.
newsitem.headline: Carolina Fincorp unit had Q1 loss.

text.p: Carolina Fincorp Inc said on Monday Richmond Savings Bank Inc incurred a net loss of $194,000 for its fiscal first quarter ended September 30 1996 compared with net income of $152,000 for the same period last year.
The net loss for the September 30 1996 period was attributed to the impact of a special insurance assessment of $519,000.

Richmond Savings completed its conversion from a mutual to a stock institution on November 22 and in connection with the conversion Carolina Fincorp Inc acquired all the outstanding stock of the savings bank.
